title: Chainalysis and Elliptic expect North Korean hackers to take months to launder the Binance proceeds, utilizing scripted automation and DeFi lending protocols (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Chainalysis and Elliptic expect North Korean hackers to take months to launder the Binance proceeds, utilizing scripted automation and DeFi lending protocols — North Korean hackers are expected to take months to launder the billions of dollars of tokens they stole last week from crypto exchange Binance …
